display_long_description:
😺 Set Up Your Cat Supermarket

Open the doors, fill the shelves, scan the items, and take the money. Work fast, work slow, run a clean little shop, or turn it into a busy cat-powered market. It is your store.

[media]

😺 Stock Shelves and Hire Cats

Bring in new products and keep every shelf full. Customers do not like empty shelves, and neither does your wallet.

Cats can work too. Put them in your store and let them stock the shelves for you. But cats will not work for free forever.

[media]

😺 Scan Items and Scratch Tickets

Scan the items, take the money, and send every customer home happy.

Sell lottery tickets to customers, or scratch them yourself. Play it safe and make steady money, or chase the lucky ticket that could make your day.

[media]

😺 Breed and Show Off Your Cats

Put two cats together and see what kind of kitten you get. Keep the cute ones, sell the valuable ones, or try again for a rare coat.

Keep your favorite cats in special Cat Zones. Let them walk around, rest, and stay near you while you work.

[media]

😺 Expand Your Supermarket

Buy more products, make your store bigger, and upgrade your shop. Build a small cozy store, a busy supermarket, or the biggest Meow Mart on the block.

[media]

Join our Discord and become a Shareholder — vote on what we build next! https://discord.gg/at5QaPDjvg
